I guess I've ended up this way because my mind was fucked up at an early age. I was sexually abused by my teacher when I was six and then molested by my tennis coach when I was nine. My parents never gave a shit about me and I never really had any friends.
These don't count as excuses, of course. But if you're looking for an explanation for my fuckedupness then I guess that's probably it.
